name: Dating Game: New Neighbors
source:
A lost cat leads you to meeting the girls that just moved to your same building block. Will you have what it takes to give them a warm welcome? Or will you fail being a good neighbor?

[From [url=https://antipodegames.itch.io/dating-game-new-neighbors]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只走失的猫，让你认识了刚搬到同一栋楼的女孩们。你能热情招待她们吗？还是会当不成一个好邻居？

［摘自[url=https://antipodegames.itch.io/dating-game-new-neighbors]Itch.io[/url]］
